articles.title: Europe’s nuclear hawks need a reality check
articles.summary: European strategists are debating establishing an autonomous nuclear defence for the continent. While some find this prospect exciting, the article cautions against its significant practical and political challenges, urging a 'reality check.' Pursuing this ambitious project would fundamentally alter Europe's security architecture and strategic independence, demanding thorough consideration of its implications for continental defence posture and stability.

articles.title: Russia accuses U.K. and France of plotting to SMUGGLE NUCLEAR WEAPON into Ukraine
articles.summary: Russia's Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR) alleges the U.K. and France are covertly planning to transfer a nuclear warhead or a radioactive "dirty bomb" to Ukraine. Moscow warns this would be a catastrophic violation of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT). This serious accusation from Russia highlights escalating tensions and has significant international security implications concerning WMD proliferation in conflict zones.
